=== Gold metal logo (30 Oct 2026) ===
[[:File:PC logo gold metal 2026.jpg]] is a gold SWCCG PLAYERS COMMITTEE mark posted by [[Chris Schoenthal]] on Facebook on 10 August 2026 (fbid 10101044224957254). Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk.

== Build notes ==
November 2021 foil stacks (topic 77970) and the remaining NextGen deck-box photograph (topic 79772, attachment 15661). The other three deck-box photographs, the pin index and the 2022 Champions League coin were already in the gallery. == Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
* Added from the old Players Committee website: Decipher's willingness to waive tournament-system costs and the PC's thanks to Warren Holland (https://web.archive.org/web/20030809101827/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/decipherdonation06182003.htm); Decipher's new tournament software, credit-card registration, one-year grace period and the PC's software subcommittee (https://web.archive.org/web/20030809102648/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/tournamentchanges06182003.htm); what the Universal Cards affiliate store sold and the commission (https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm); the Vancouver and Long Island fundraiser tournaments (https://web.archive.org/web/20040620113020/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/WAfundraiser1.htm, https://web.archive.org/web/20040616153119/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/NYfundraiser1.htm); the December 2002 holiday charity tournaments (https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm); why the 2004 approval fees were omitted and what they paid for, and the overseas shipping surcharge (https://web.archive.org/web/20040603213235/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Fees_and_Prizes.htm); the DeckTech DPC Championship series (https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm, https://web.archive.org/web/20040604153526/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/dpcchicago.htm).
* '''Missing data:''' both fundraisers are cited from their announcements only; no result or attendance report was found, so the article says they were scheduled. The Vancouver announcement is signed by David Kangas, who asks readers to contact him, but it does not call him the tournament director, so no TD credit was written.

=== Missing data ===
* The 2004 Florida States and NJ Open use of the Ultimate Package (gap list): not in the 2004 Tennessee States topic that was cited for it.
* Topic 2267 (post 34135) repeats the 6 October 2003 uncut-sheet announcement; one citation (topic 2268) is used.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Post 36496 (Cam Solusar, Nov 2003): a player's claim that the PC held rights to the game text of all cards but not icons or pictures. Not an official statement; left out.
* Post 34203 (Jim Colson, Oct 2003): about "(100?)" uncut sheets given to Andrew Howard "after GenCon"; the number is uncertain and the Winter Classic prize status is an inference. Left out.
* Post 55368 (David Kangas resignation post, Oct 2004): says Decipher supported the PC financially while Andrew Howard was an Advocate. Hostile post; Decipher's financial support is already on the page. Left out.
* Post 61872 (Feb 2005 offer to redesign the site): "no staff reply" is an absence-of-evidence inference. Left out.
* Posts 37822 (player opinion on a paid magazine), 59718 ("IIRC" recollection of booster boxes, superseded by the Ultimate Package contents in post 58970) and 60524 (whether a New Year's Resolutions contest awarded a design right is not stated) were left out.
